name: Pócsa (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated vertical stripe of red and green triangles at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Pócsa (a blue shield with a bunch of grapes and a sun) within a green wreath, below a scroll inscribed PÓCSA 1332–1997.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pócsa arms with wreath and scroll
